sources.licence: Project data; product names © BANDAI SPIRITS. Korean/Japanese MS names marked names_src 'kit' are taken from these product names. names_src 'translit' marks an unofficial Korean reading generated from the Japanese name (lexicon learned from GGET's official Korean names).

methods.jan: JAN -> Gunplapedia kit page 'Model of' -> Gundam Wiki title
methods.name_exact: cleaned kit name = MS name (Gundam Wiki kanji / GGET)
methods.model: model number in the kit name (RXF-91改 -> the 改 member of the family)
methods.pilot_custom: <pilot>専用<MS>: pilot table or a page naming the pilot (variant noted); base MS when neither exists (listed in the review queue)
methods.set_split: set name split into members; each member runs the name cascade
methods.name_contains: longest specific MS name contained in the kit name
methods.name_suffix: short box name that ends a full MS name (e.g. バンシィ・ノルン)
methods.name_prefix: long box name that starts a full MS name (e.g. ユニコーンガンダム2号機 -> ...2号機・バンシィ)

roles.set_member: one of several MS in the kit
roles.accessory_for: parts / effects / weapons for this MS
roles.figure: finished figure (ROBOT魂, METAL BUILD, MSE ...) of this MS
roles.sd_character: SD original character (BB戦士 三国伝, 武者, 騎士, SDW HEROES) whose design borrows this MS
